personal.name: Punnya
personal.headline: HR Operations & Brand Strategist
personal.tagline: Where people strategy meets brand storytelling. Bridging internal workplace culture with external brand identity.
personal.subcopy: MBA graduate specializing in Human Resources and Marketing. Practical internship experience across cooperative infrastructure, financial equities, and commercial real estate.

paragraphs: I am an enthusiastic and dedicated MBA graduate specializing in Human Resources and Marketing from Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering. Equipped with practical internship experience across both HR operations and customer-facing sales environments, I bring a well-rounded perspective to people management and brand communication.

With a strong undergraduate foundation in B.A. English from Sree Narayana College, I bring crisp verbal communication, active listening, and meticulous documentation skills to the workplace. My hands-on exposure includes talent operations at a premier financial brokerage (Hedge Equities), personnel administration at a major worker cooperative (ULCCS), and client engagement at a landmark business hub (Hilite Business Park).

Known as a quick learner, proactive team collaborator, and detail-oriented organizer, I am eager to contribute to a progressive organization where professional learning and meaningful impact are valued.
